assumptions.box_meaning: deterministic allowance; no probabilistic independence or statistical interpretation
assumptions.chemical_repetitions: three samples per configuration; TDS and EY explicitly averaged
assumptions.composition: combine shared source coefficients before bounds; marginal extrema cannot be combined arbitrarily
assumptions.duration: reported condition duration; statistic, spread, rounding and clock convention unknown
assumptions.grind: ordinal within coffee; Optimal recipe-defined; no calibrated cross-coffee or Cameron mapping
assumptions.illustration_meaning: conditional nearest-second illustration; source rounding rule not authenticated
assumptions.layer_A: exact arithmetic on printed durations; reported zero is not physical equality
assumptions.layer_B: one common entrywise box tau_i* in [tau_i-h,tau_i+h], h>=0 seconds
assumptions.lineage: thesis Table 4.3 and Egidi Table 2 are the same Modœtia observations; canonical egidi2024/table2
assumptions.observation_unit: reported condition row; not authenticated individual shot
assumptions.pressure: native nominal machine labels; reference, sensor node and actual history unknown
assumptions.sigma: TDS standard deviation, not duration uncertainty
